items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle (ALB) to Outperform from Neutral and maintained a $130 price target. The firm pointed to stronger demand from battery energy stationary storage, or BESS, as a reason the lithium market could become tighter than previously expected.

items.headline: [US Featured Stock] Albemarle, investment rating upgraded on lithium demand outlook... stock price slightly up
items.snippet: US lithium producer Albemarle (ALB) is seeing its stock price rise slightly as its investment rating is upgraded following analysis that lithium demand is stronger than expected. As of 1:36 PM on the 14th, Albemarle's stock is trading at $97.71.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory; raising 2027 Energy Storage price forecast to $21k from $17k.
